BETA Close X The Sage Group plc announced the purchase of 572,129 ordinary shares on 22 May 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The highest price paid per share was 883.0000 pence, the lowest was 875.0000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price was 878.7679 pence. These purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 22 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
